name: Push-Up
cues: Hands under shoulders, body in a straight line
Push the floor away and brace your core

name: Goblet Squat
cues: Hold weight close to chest, elbows under
Sit hips down and back between your heels
Keep chest up and knees tracking over toes

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
cues: Support hand on bench, back flat
Pull elbow toward hip, not shoulder
Squeeze shoulder blade at the top
